base: Create ONE portrait full-bleed game map concept map12 'Pyramid descending corridor'. Mandatory ART STYLE refs1-2: polished RPG Maker / tsukuru high 3/4 overhead hand-painted pixel-clusters, crisp material-colored variable outlines, clean cream/honey sandstone planes, peach reflected midtones, warm umber contact shadows, restrained fine texture. Ref1 gives interior stone rendering ONLY, do not import columns, furniture, pots, plants, flame niches or decoration. Ref2 gives identity and masonry material of map05 pyramid entrance ONLY, do NOT copy exterior courtyard, pylons, sand dunes or ANKH symbols. New INTERIOR transitional passage connecting05 to13, medium portrait approx2:3. High overhead orthographic-like game floor camera, NOT first-person tunnel view, no vanishing-point cinematic perspective, no horizon/sky, no isometric floating island. Roof removed for gameplay visibility; close massive sandstone sidewalls, generous broad stairs descending from upper entrance landing to lower darker corridor exit. Bright diffuse daylight enters from upper doorway and fades gradually into restrained warm brown shadow deeper down; NO narrow light beam or glowing puzzle laser. Walkable floor visible even at dark end. Several large stair treads and a slightly expanded intermediate landing with ONE accessible worn inscription panel on inward-facing wall. Subtle shallow incised reeds, waves and birds only, NO ankh or loop topped crosses, no modern text. Space before panel for standing aside while companions pass. Clear wide landing at top05 return and bottom13 exit. Large ancient stone blocks, worn edges, clean planes, sparse sand near upper entrance only, little rubble at margins not obstructing route. No statues, loot, puzzle mechanisms, colored light crystals, gates, locks, coffins, lavish columns or unrelated rooms. No uniform black rings, white piping, purple filter, monochrome orange wash, microcrack noise. One coherent standalone painted game map, no montage, labels, arrows, grid, UI or characters. Fixed passage and wall only, emphasis effects and foreground layers separate later.
variants: Variant1: Straight north-south axial passage. Upper flight leads down to a broad central landing widened to right for inscription, second lower flight reaches bottom exit. Massive parallel sidewalls, asymmetric erosion, quiet dark lower landing.

Variant2: Shallow dogleg passage: bright entrance upper-left, first broad descent to centered landing, landing extends right with inscription on its back wall, second broad stair flight offset right descends toward bottom-right exit. No maze, one clearly continuous route.

Variant3: One long broad staircase occupies upper half, leads to large lower intermediate landing with inscription in a shallow left wall recess; a short last descent exits at bottom-center. Close thick walls and visually deep masonry, top daylight reaches halfway only.

Variant4: Two short broad stair flights separated by an elongated slightly diagonal landing, upper entrance right-of-center, lower exit left-of-center, subtle S alignment without sharp maze turns. Inscription on right inward-facing wall beside widest middle landing. Restrained warm shadows and worn large sandstone blocks.
